metadata.title: CapRover · Scalable, Free and Self-hosted PaaS
metadata.description: Deploy and manage apps on your own infrastructure with CapRover, the free and open-source PaaS built on Docker.

dashboardAlt: CapRover dashboard showing apps organized by project

hero.description: A scalable, free platform that makes deploying and managing your apps simple, while keeping your infrastructure fully under your control.

intro.titleLine1: The power of Docker and nginx.
intro.description: CapRover gives you a clean interface for the infrastructure tasks that usually steal hours from building your product.

community.title: Support the project. Stay in the loop.
community.supportDescription: Help fund ongoing development and maintenance through OpenCollective.
community.subscribeDescription: Get notified about new CapRover releases. No noise, just product updates.

workflow.title: From localhost to live in seconds.
workflow.description: Bring your code. CapRover handles the build, deployment, routing, HTTPS, and ongoing management.

featuresSection.title: A simple control plane for your apps.
featuresSection.description: Easy enough for your first deployment. Flexible enough when you need complete control.

items.title: Any language
items.description: Deploy Node.js, Python, PHP, Java, Ruby, .NET, or any app that runs in a container.

items.title: One-click apps
items.description: Launch databases, WordPress, monitoring tools, and dozens of popular services in seconds.

items.title: Flexible deploys
items.description: Deploy from the dashboard, CLI, webhook, or your existing Git workflow.

items.title: Automatic HTTPS
items.description: Issue and renew Let's Encrypt certificates, with one-click HTTP to HTTPS redirects.

items.title: Simple control
items.description: Manage ports, persistent directories, environment variables, and instance counts from one place.

items.title: Ready to scale
items.description: Add nodes to your Docker Swarm cluster and let CapRover handle load balancing.

audience.title: Spend more time writing code. Less time managing servers.
audience.simpleDescription: Skip the repetitive server setup, certificates, nginx edits, and deployment scripts.
audience.powerfulDescription: Customize nginx, attach nodes, use custom certificates, and reach the underlying Docker platform.

tutorial.title: A full deployment, from server to shipped app.
tutorial.description: Watch the original step-by-step tutorial to see how CapRover is installed, configured, and used to deploy an application.
tutorial.linkAriaLabel: Watch the CapRover video tutorial on YouTube
tutorial.imageAlt: Animated preview of the CapRover video tutorial

blueprints.title: The complete deployment flow, under the hood.
blueprints.description: Explore the original CapRover workflow and architecture diagrams for a closer look at what happens from deploy command to live application.
blueprints.workflowAlt: CapRover deployment workflow from source code to a running application
blueprints.workflowDescription: From source code to live app
blueprints.architectureAlt: CapRover architecture showing Docker Swarm, nginx, services, and applications

finalCta.kicker: READY TO GIVE IT A SHOT?
finalCta.title: Your first deployment is about 10 minutes away.
finalCta.description: Install CapRover on your own server and ship your first app today.
